# ankra_cluster_access_grant (Resource)

Kubernetes access to a cluster through the Ankra gateway for one organisation member. The counterpart of `ankra cluster access grant` and `ankra cluster access revoke`.

Once a grant's expiry has passed the platform retires it, and the next plan proposes creating it again; move `expires_at` forward or remove the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster" "prod" {
  name = "prod"
}

resource "ankra_cluster_access_grant" "oncall" {
  cluster_id = data.ankra_cluster.prod.id
  user_email = "oncall@example.com"
  role       = "edit"
  expires_at = "2026-12-31T23:00:00Z"
  reason     = "Migration window"
}

resource "ankra_cluster_access_grant" "team_view" {
  cluster_id = data.ankra_cluster.prod.id
  user_email = "developer@example.com"
  scope      = "namespace"
  namespace  = "payments"
  role       = "view"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `role` (String) `view`, `edit`, `admin` or `cluster-admin`. Changing it replaces the grant.
- `user_email` (String) Email of the organisation member the grant is for. Changing it replaces the grant.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 time the grant ends. Unset is a standing grant. A change is applied in place while `expires_at` is set (the platform re-times the grant); otherwise it replaces the grant.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace the grant is bound to; required when `scope` is `namespace` and refused otherwise. Changing it replaces the grant.
- `reason` (String) Justification recorded with the grant; the organisation access policy may require one. A change is applied in place while `expires_at` is set (the platform re-times the grant); otherwise it replaces the grant.
- `scope` (String) `cluster` or `namespace`. Defaults to `cluster`. Changing it replaces the grant.

### Read-Only

- `ankra_user_id` (String) Identifier of the member the grant is for.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the grant.
- `reconcile_status` (String) Whether the grant's binding has been applied on the cluster.
- `source` (String) Where the grant came from: `manual`, `creator`, `role` or `elevated`; null when the platform cannot tell.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Grants are imported by cluster id and grant id.
terraform import ankra_cluster_access_grant.oncall 0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666/7c1e9a52-0d4b-4f8e-9a77-2f3c5d6e7f80
```
